element: Splash routing; ONBOARDING_DONE and GUEST_MODE reads
found: After a 2.6 s timer the splash always calls router.replace('/(tabs)') (line 33). It reads the SecureStore token (line 27) and AsyncStorage GUEST_MODE (line 28) and throws both values away. ONBOARDING_DONE is written in three places (app/(onboarding)/index.tsx:70, permissions.tsx:62, app/(auth)/otp.tsx:152) and read nowhere; the GUEST_MODE key ('@nabdah_guest_mode') is never written anywhere. The router.replace('/(auth)/welcome') at line 35 runs only if the AsyncStorage read rejects.
suspect: The first-run flow (onboarding, language, permissions, welcome) is never shown on a fresh install: the user lands on Home with no session. The two reads are dead code. Owner decision needed on the launch routing (first run to /(onboarding), no session to /(auth)/welcome, or public-first Home with a guest session created silently).

element: Onboarding intro, language and permissions screens: no entry point
found: No file in app/ or src/ outside app/(onboarding) pushes or replaces to /(onboarding) (grep for '(onboarding)'); the only references are the Stack.Screen in app/_layout.tsx:98 and a type in src/types/index.ts:651. The three screens chain to each other (intro to language to permissions to /(auth)/welcome) but nothing starts the chain.
suspect: Three finished screens that a user cannot reach except by deep link. Same cause as the splash item; they need the launch routing decision.

element: Home bell: unread dot
found: The dot shows when redux state.notifications.unreadCount > 0. The slice's actions (setNotifications, addNotification, markAsRead, markAllAsRead; src/store/slices/notificationsSlice.ts:21-39) are dispatched nowhere (grep over src and app); the notifications screen keeps its own local list (app/notifications/index.tsx:105) and never touches the store. The count is therefore always 0 and the dot never appears.
suspect: A counter nothing updates. Either read the count from the API (the backend list returns read per row, there is no unread-count endpoint) or have the notifications screen and the push handler dispatch to the slice.

element: Next appointment card: 'التفاصيل' button
found: Pushes /consultations/appointment-detail with params {id: appointment.id}. That screen reads params.appointmentId (app/consultations/appointment-detail.tsx:24-27) and returns without loading when it is missing; loading stays true, so it shows the spinner forever.
suspect: Wrong param name: the details button opens an endless spinner. Pass appointmentId (the notifications translator already does: src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts:48).

element: Greeting card name (and avatar initial)
found: The name is taken from GET /users/me/profile fields full_name, name, display_name. The endpoint returns the patient_profiles document (backend/src/modules/users/users.service.ts:95-101). The schema has full_name (backend/src/schemas/patient-profile.schema.ts:22) but no name or display_name, and registration creates that document with only user_id (backend/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:549, also 837 and 1108 for guest and social), so the name typed at registration is stored on the user record only. GET /users/me/display returns display_name from the user record (users.service.ts:123-132) but Home does not call it.
suspect: A registered patient is greeted without a name until the profile is edited elsewhere. Read the name from GET /users/me/display (display_name), or have registration write full_name to the patient profile (backend).

element: Home top row: dark-mode switch
found: toggleTheme flips the previous mode with next = (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'). The default mode is 'system'. When the device is dark, isDark is true with mode 'system'; the first tap sets 'dark' and nothing changes on screen.
suspect: The first press of the switch can do nothing. Toggle from the effective isDark instead of the stored mode.

element: Route collisions: '/' (three files) and '/services' (two files)
found: Three files resolve to the URL '/': app/index.tsx (splash), app/(tabs)/index.tsx (Home) and app/(onboarding)/index.tsx (intro). Two resolve to '/services': app/(tabs)/services.tsx (Services tab: tiles and search pill) and app/services/index.tsx ('All services' guide, 23 rows). Callers using the bare URL: Home 'كل الخدمات' router.push('/services') (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:138) and the notifications back fallback router.replace('/') (app/notifications/index.tsx:160). Callers that include the group name ('/(tabs)', '/(onboarding)/language') are not ambiguous. The screen inventory lists both pairs under the same route.
suspect: Which file renders for '/' and for '/services' is decided by expo-router's tie-break; I cannot determine it from the code. If '/services' lands on the tab screen, the 23-row guide is unreachable from Home; if it lands on the guide, the Services tab screen has no entry point (MainTabBar has no Services tab). Needs a device check or one path per screen (owner decision).

element: Points card (نقاط نبض+ / تخصم حتى ١٠٪ من قيمة طلبك)
found: The card is static copy and a push to /loyalty/hub; Home makes no loyalty call and shows no points number. Endpoints exist: GET /loyalty/account (backend/src/modules/loyalty/loyalty.controller.ts:22-26, returns points, lifetime_points, tier) and GET /loyalty/config (:16-20, whose max_redeem_percent comes only from loyalty_config overrides and is undefined when not overridden, loyalty.service.ts:70-87). The real cap is max_redeem_percent in the finance-engine settings, default 10 (backend/src/modules/finance-engine/finance-engine.module.ts:47,354), a different store.
suspect: The '١٠٪' is a hard-coded number that an admin can change, and the card shows no balance. Add GET /loyalty/account to Home and read the cap from an endpoint that returns the effective value, or drop the figure. Backend gap: /loyalty/config does not return the effective cap.

element: Curated sections: card tap (deep_link) and title_en
found: A tap runs router.push(item.deep_link) with whatever string the admin typed. The backend save keeps id, title_ar, image_url and deep_link per item, cut to 160 characters, with no check against app routes (backend/src/modules/admin/enterprise/admin-governance-controls.controller.ts:41-46). The client also reads title_en for sections and items (HomeSections.tsx:13-14,36), which the save never writes.
suspect: A mistyped or external deep_link pushes an unmatched route. Validate deep_link against an allow-list of app routes on save, or on the client before pushing. title_en is dead until the admin form writes it.

element: Submit button: failed login clears the stored session
found: login.tsx calls POST /auth/login through utils/api.ts apiFetch without skipAuth. A 401 from the login itself (wrong password: 'Invalid credentials', backend auth.service.ts:564-571) runs clearStoredSession(), which deletes the access token, refresh token and user data from SecureStore (utils/api.ts:37-41,95-97). The request also carries the existing guest token as Authorization.
suspect: A mistyped password signs out the current guest session. Pass skipAuth: true for /auth/login, /auth/guest and /auth/social-login.

element: Session state after login and social login
found: Password login stores the tokens (storeAuthSession) but dispatches nothing to redux; only the OTP screen dispatches loginSuccess (app/(auth)/otp.tsx:154) and Welcome dispatches guestLogin. The auth slice is blacklisted from persistence (src/store/persistence/config.ts: blacklist 'auth') and nothing restores it from SecureStore (SessionManager is not connected to the store). NotificationHandler registers the push token and its listeners only when state.auth.isAuthenticated is true (src/components/NotificationHandler.tsx:89-92); useGuestGuard reads state.auth.isGuest. The social path (src/hooks/useSocialLogin.ts:72-79) writes only the access token, to SecureStore, and falls back to plaintext AsyncStorage when SecureStore throws (the OTP screen's own comment says never to fall back), drops the refresh token and dispatches nothing.
suspect: After a password or social login the app can still treat the user as a guest (isGuest stays true if a guest session came first) and may never register for push notifications. Unclear whether another component hydrates the slice; I found none. The AsyncStorage token fallback breaks the 'no tokens in localStorage' rule (QUALITY_STANDARDS section 4).

element: Two api helpers and three base-URL resolutions
found: login.tsx, welcome.tsx and useSocialLogin.ts use utils/api.ts (axios HttpClient, base EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL + /api/v1 else https://api.nabd.plus/api/v1: src/services/HttpClient.ts:5-8). register, otp, forgot-password, reset-password, Home, search and notifications use src/utils/api.ts (fetch, base config.apiBaseUrl from ConfigManager: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL else a per-environment default, localhost:8002 in dev: src/core/config/ConfigManager.ts:49-70). src/constants/index.ts:12-13 defines a third rule. Only src/utils/api.ts adds Idempotency-Key and its 401 handling differs.
suspect: In a build where EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL differ or only one is set, sign-in and the guest session go to one host and the rest of the app to another. Same behaviour should come from one client.

element: Identifier validation (phone.length < 9)
found: The same check is applied to an email and to a phone: anything shorter than 9 characters shows 'أدخل بريد إلكتروني أو هاتف صحيح' and nothing is sent. A valid short email such as a@b.sa (6 characters) is refused before the request.
suspect: Validate an email by its shape, and a phone by its digits, separately.

element: Error box: server messages in English
found: The error box shows err.message, which the api helper takes from the server's message. The backend answers in English ('Invalid credentials', 'Account disabled': auth.service.ts:564-571); the phrase catalogue (src/i18n) has no entry for them, so autoTranslate shows them as is. The same happens on the OTP and register screens ('OTP expired or not requested', 'Invalid OTP code', 'Too many OTP requests...', 'Email already registered').
suspect: Arabic and Urdu users see English sentences. Map the server's error codes or messages to catalogue phrases in the app, or have the backend return codes.

element: Social buttons (Google, X, Snapchat): request hooks with empty client ids
found: useSocialLogin runs Google.useAuthRequest with clientId, iosClientId and androidClientId set to '' when the env vars are missing (lines 88-92), and AuthSession.useAuthRequest for X and Snapchat with clientId '' (lines 107-114), at render on both Welcome and Login. The hook's comment expects the button to show 'not available' when pressed.
suspect: Unsure: expo-auth-session's Google provider may throw on a missing platform client id while rendering; node_modules is not installed in this worktree, so I could not read the library. Needs a run without the env vars.

element: POST /auth/social-login: the backend does not verify the Apple, X and Snapchat tokens
found: The app sends {provider, token} (Apple: the identity token; X and Snapchat: an opaque OAuth access token; Google: an access token). backend/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts socialLogin (1068-1117): Google is checked against Google's userinfo endpoint (verifyGoogleToken, 1119-1135); Apple only base64-decodes the middle part of the JWT, with no signature, issuer or audience check (1137-1151); X and Snapchat accept any string: a token that is not a three-part JWT, which is what the app sends, gives a made-up email x_user_<4 digits>@nabd.app or snapchat_user_<4 digits>@nabd.app (verifyXToken 1153-1167, verifySnapchatToken 1169-1185). The email is then used to find or create a user and a session token is returned, with no role check on the found user.
suspect: Apple sign-in can be forged with a hand-made JWT for any email (including an existing account); X and Snapchat sign-ins create a new throw-away account each time and are not tied to the provider account. Backend fix needed: verify Apple identity tokens against Apple's keys, verify X and Snapchat access tokens with their user endpoints, and refuse privileged roles on this route.

element: Submit: duplicate email or phone found only after the OTP step
found: POST /auth/send-otp {email, purpose:'register'} sends a code to any email, registered or not (backend auth.service.ts:956-967 ignores the existing account when purpose is 'register'). The duplicate is rejected by POST /auth/register ('Phone already registered' / 'Email already registered', auth.service.ts:492,496), after the user has entered the code, and the message is English (otp.tsx:164).
suspect: The user does the whole OTP step before learning the account exists. A duplicate check before sending the code is a backend change (it must not reveal accounts to other flows; a register-only check is acceptable).

element: 'إعادة إرسال الرمز' link
found: Resend calls POST /auth/send-otp with {identifier} and no purpose. For a not-yet-registered email the backend returns {ok:true, channel} and sends nothing (backend auth.service.ts:956-960: no account and purpose !== 'register'). The first send from the register screen did pass purpose:'register'.
suspect: In register mode the resend resets the 60 s timer and clears the boxes while no code was sent. Pass purpose:'register' when mode is register. (The backend also limits issuing to 3 codes per hour per identifier, auth.service.ts:942-954; the error is shown in English.)

element: Reset flow: the code is verified on this screen and asked for again on reset-password
found: In mode reset the screen calls POST /auth/verify-otp {email, code}; the backend deletes the code when it is valid (auth.service.ts:1027) and leaves only a 10-minute 'verified' marker used by register. The screen then opens /(auth)/reset-password, which asks for the code again and sends it to POST /auth/reset-password; resetPassword calls verifyOtp on that code again (auth.service.ts:1045-1060) and does not look at the marker, so it answers 'OTP expired or not requested' (400).
suspect: Password reset cannot succeed through the screens as built, unless the user requests a new code in between, which no screen offers. Either skip verify-otp in reset mode and let reset-password verify the code once, or make resetPassword accept the verified marker (backend).

element: Register path stores the session; mode 'login'
found: POST /auth/register answers {user, token:{accessToken, refreshToken}} (auth.service.ts:553, signToken at 50-62). The screen keeps only accessToken (SecureStore.setItemAsync, line 144) and dispatches loginSuccess without refreshToken (line 154); the refresh token is dropped (login.tsx uses storeAuthSession and keeps both). The default mode is 'login' (line 24) but no caller passes it (register passes 'register', forgot-password 'reset'); a verify-only response has no token, so that mode always ends in 'رمز غير صحيح أو الحساب غير موجود' (lines 130-141). params.phone is never passed either.
suspect: A newly registered user has no refresh token, so the 1-hour access token ends the session without renewal (access tokens last 1 h: auth.service.ts:53). The login mode and the phone param are dead code.

element: Submit 'إرسال رمز التحقق' with an invalid email
found: if (!email || !email.includes('@')) return; ends the handler silently: no message, no field error, no request.
suspect: A button that does nothing for an empty or malformed email. Show an inline error.

element: Submit 'حفظ كلمة المرور' with invalid input; missing email param
found: if (pw.length < 6 || pw !== confirmPw || !code.trim()) return; ends silently; only the mismatch has an error line (when the confirm field is non-empty); a password under 6 characters or an empty code gives no message. The email comes only from the route param (line 92); opened without it, identifier '' is sent.
suspect: Silent no-op on short password and empty code. Show the reason inline. See also the double verification of the code (OTP item).

element: Rows whose destination does not match their label
found: 'فحص النظر' and 'طب الأسنان' (MORE_SERVICES, lines 203-204) both push /consultations/specialty-select with no parameter, and that screen takes none (app/consultations/specialty-select.tsx has no search-param read): both open the same unfiltered specialty list. In SERVICE_GROUPS 'الأشعة والتصوير' (line 217) opens the lab tab like 'التحاليل المخبرية' (line 216), and 'المساعد الطبي الذكي' (line 235) opens /ai/symptom-checker while the Home card with the same title opens /ai-assistant (HomeParts.tsx:158-184, index.tsx:136).
suspect: Rows that look specific but lead to a generic screen. Decide the intended targets (a specialty param, a radiology tab, one assistant entry).

element: ?view=doctors list (DoctorSearchView): response shape and field names
found: GET /care/doctors answers {page, limit, total, items: [...]} (backend/src/modules/care/care.service.ts:78-165). The view reads Array.isArray(res?.data) ? res.data : Array.isArray(res) ? res : [] (line 47), so it always gets []. Its field mapping (lines 53-68) also reads names the server does not send: specialty_ar, degree, consultation_fee, price, average_wait, offers_online/clinic/home, facility_name, clinic_name, next_available_slot. The server sends name_ar, name_en, specialty, title, academic_degree, price_clinic, price_online, price_home, consultation_modes[], hospital, next_available_at, accepts_insurance, rating, reviews_count (care.service.ts:259-292).
suspect: The doctor search view always shows 'لا توجد نتائج'. Read items, and map the real fields.

element: ?view=doctors: query parameters and search button
found: The call is /care/doctors?search=<text>&sort=<rating|price|wait>. The controller reads q, and sort accepts rating, price_asc, price_desc, experience, distance_asc, distance_desc (backend care.controller.ts:29-58); 'search' is ignored and 'price' and 'wait' are not valid values. The route param specialty is put into the search text (line 28) rather than sent as specialty. handleSearch (line 87) is defined and never attached to the input; the text filter runs locally on the (empty) result.
suspect: The text search and two of the three sorts do nothing on the server. Use q, price_asc, and drop the 'wait' sort (the server has no wait data) or add it.

element: ?view=pharmacy: redirect drops the query
found: ?view=pharmacy renders <Redirect href="/search" />, so q and view are dropped and the global search opens empty. app/ai/prescription-translator.tsx:255 pushes {pathname: '/search', params: {q: <medicine>, view: 'pharmacy'}} and app/pharmacy/product-search.tsx redirects here too.
suspect: The prescription translator's 'تفاصيل' button lands on an empty search instead of the medicine. Redirect to /search with q kept (and no view).

element: Result tap: package and insurance results
found: A package ('باقة') result opens /(tabs)/health (line 118) and an insurer ('تأمين') result opens /insurance/hub (line 124), both without the result id; the other kinds pass id or slug to a detail screen.
suspect: Tapping a specific package or insurer opens a generic tab or hub, not the item shown. Needs a detail route or an owner decision.

element: Row tap: routes the app cannot translate do nothing
found: openNotif pushes only when translateBackendRoute(n.route) returns a target (src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts:33-77); otherwise the row is marked read and nothing happens (no inbox fallback, unlike routeFromNotificationData). Routes the backend writes that the translator returns null for: /wallet/hub (backend/src/modules/notifications/notifications.service.ts:1093,1120), /family/permission-request (956), /reports/:id for 'report ready' (667), /community/post-detail?id=... (1046; the query is stripped and the path is not in the verbatim list), and the engagement nudges' generic /${kind}/${ref_id} (backend/src/modules/engagement/engagement.controller.ts:135). Two of those targets have an app file (family/permission-request, community/post-detail); /wallet/hub and /reports/:id have none (route check over app/).
suspect: Tapping these notifications only marks them read. Add the routes to the translator, create the wallet screen or change the backend route.

element: Row tap: results and reports param name
found: /health/results/:id and /health/reports/:id are translated to /reports/view-report with params {reportId}. app/reports/view-report.tsx reads params.id (lines 65-71) and shows its error state when it is missing.
suspect: Wrong param name: lab-result and report notifications open an error screen. Pass id.

element: Row title and body language
found: listForUser resolves title_key and body_key with lang = user?.lang || 'ar'. The access token carries no lang (signToken, backend/src/modules/auth/auth.service.ts:51), nothing else sets req.user.lang (grep), and the app sends no language to GET /notifications. The notifications screen comment says the text is 'already in the user's language'.
suspect: Every notification is returned in Arabic whatever the app language. Pass the app language (query or Accept-Language) to the endpoint, or put lang in the session.

element: Row icon and filter group by notification type
found: The client maps type to icon and filter group (src/utils/notificationsFeed.ts:39-49). The backend writes appointment created, confirmed and completed (lines 694, 704, 716) and report-ready (667) with type INFO, although the enum has APPOINTMENT and PRESCRIPTION (backend/src/common/enums.ts:172-181). The client's 'labs' key is not in the enum, so it never occurs.
suspect: Appointment notifications show the info icon and land in the 'تحديثات' chip instead of 'طبي'. Write the specific type in the backend, and drop 'labs' from the map.

element: Row time for items older than 30 days
found: relativeTime formats an old date with the dateLocale argument, which the screen fills with dateLocale() (app/notifications/index.tsx:37), the Arabic locale 'ar-SA-u-ca-gregory'. src/utils/dates.ts:78 has dateLocaleFor(lang) for the app language.
suspect: English, Urdu and other users see Arabic-script dates and digits on old notifications. Use dateLocaleFor(lang).

element: Next appointment card: doctor name
found: getUpcomingAppointment reads the doctor name from provider_profiles with doctorName = prov?.name || ''. The provider profile schema declares no top-level name (name_ar, name_en, display_name_ar, display_name_en: backend/src/schemas/provider-profile.schema.ts:25-26,215-216; the only 'name' is inside the facility roster sub-schema, line 144). The result is null, and Home hides the doctor line when it is null. The same field is read in getOffers (line 41) and the package search (lines 156) for provider names.
suspect: Unsure whether older documents hold a name field; by the schema the card never shows the doctor. Read display_name_ar / name_ar (backend).
